versions.content: When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunctions 0x14, the Dcm module shall obtain the DTCFaultCounter of every DTCs with status "prefailed" by repeatedly calling Dem_GetNextFilteredDTCAndFDC() after having configured the filter with Dem_SetDTCFilter() using the parameter values according to Table 7.23.
